text: In categorical logic, universal quantification ∀x. P(x) is modeled by:
choices: the left adjoint to the pullback functor
the right adjoint to the pullback functor (dependent product)
explanation: ∀ = right adjoint (Π) to substitution/pullback; ∃ = left adjoint (Σ) to substitution/pullback. This is the Beck-Chevalley / hyperdoctrine structure.
